title: Worker brief + return contract
description: The self-contained task an orchestrator hands a cold worker (kind=brief) and the summary-only result the worker hands back (kind=return). One document is one or the other, discriminated by `kind`. The return shape enforces 'summary only, never the trajectory' by omission — additionalProperties:false and no field for a tool log — so a conforming return literally cannot carry the reasoning trace. See framework/coordination/fan-out.md.

objective.description: What to accomplish, stated as the outcome — not the steps.

inputs.description: The self-contained context a cold worker needs. A worker starts with zero conversation history; everything load-bearing lives here.

constraints.description: The boundaries: what NOT to touch, scope fence, invariants to hold. At least one — an unbounded worker broadens scope.

stance.description: The skeptical posture the worker takes — e.g. verify before reporting, burden of proof on the implementer, flag deviations rather than absorb them.

verify_bar.description: The definition of done. For a build brief: an executable check. For a recon brief: the deliverable bar (e.g. 'a WIRING covering X, Y, Z'). Required — a brief without a definition of done is the artifact this primitive exists to reject.

tool_guidance.description: Optional: which tools/sources to prefer or avoid.

hold_point.description: Optional: where the worker must stop and hand back (e.g. 'HOLD at WIRING').

plan_anchor.description: Optional: the plan slice / task id this brief serves.

questions.description: Optional: specific recon/build questions the return must answer.

deviation_policy.description: Optional: how the worker should handle a needed deviation from the brief (default: flag it, don't silently absorb).

return_contract.description: The declared output shape — fan-out.md's non-negotiable. A worker without a declared return shape duplicates effort and leaves gaps.

required_fields.description: The fields the return must carry. Must include 'summary' — the condensed result is the whole point of fanning out.

summary_max_chars.description: The cap the brief hands the worker. A character proxy for the ~1–2K token summary target — chars are not tokens, so this is a ceiling, not an exact token count.

status.description: done = objective met; blocked = partial, hit an obstacle; needs-input = waiting on a decision only the orchestrator can make.

summary.description: The condensed, schema-shaped result — never the reasoning trace or tool log. The static maxLength is a hard ceiling; the brief's summary_max_chars is the tighter per-task cap, enforced by the validator when a contract is supplied.

evidence.description: What proves the verify bar was met — commands run + observed output, file paths, verdicts. At least one item.

deviations.description: Optional: anything done differently from the brief, flagged for the orchestrator to ratify.

fence_respected.description: Optional: confirmation the scope fence / constraints were honored.

artifacts.description: Optional: file paths produced or changed.

follow_ups.description: Optional: open items or recommended next steps.
